claim:
    ? forall x R, n N:
        x^(2*n) >= 0
    x^(2*n) = (x^n)^2 >= 0

forall x R, n N:
    x^(2*n) >= 0

forall x R, t R:
    x^(2*t) >= 0

forall x,y R+:
    ln(x) <= ln(y)
    =>:
        x <= y

claim:
    ? forall a,x,y R+:
        1 < a
        log(a,x) <= log(a,y)
        =>:
            x <= y
    by contra:
        ? x <= y
        y < x
        log(a,y) < log(a,x)
        impossible log(a,x) <= log(a,y)

forall a,x,y R+:
    1 < a
    log(a,x) <= log(a,y)
    =>:
        x <= y

forall a,x,y R+:
    a < 1
    x < y
    =>:
        log(a,x) > log(a,y)

forall a,x,y R+:
    a < 1
    x < y
    =>:
        log(a,x) < log(a,y)

forall a,b R:
    0 <= a
    0 <= b
    =>:
        min(a,b) $in R+

claim:
    ? forall x,a,b R:
        x < a
        x < b
        =>:
            x < min(a,b)
    a <= b or a > b
    by cases:
        ? x < min(a,b)
        case a <= b:
            x < a = min(a,b)
        case a > b:
            x < b = min(a,b)

forall x,a,b R:
    x < a
    x < b
    =>:
        x < min(a,b)

    =>:

have a,b,c R+
have delta R+ = finite_set_min(union({finite_set_min(union({a},{b}))},{c}))

have a,b,c R+
have first R+ = finite_set_min(union({a},{b}))
have delta R+ = finite_set_min(union({first},{c}))

forall a,b,c R:
    min(min(a,b),c) <= min(a,b) <= a

forall a,b,c R:
    min(min(a,b),c) <= a

have a,b,c R+
have delta R+ = min(min(a,b),c)

have a,b,c R+
have first R+ = min(a,b)
have delta R+ = min(first,c)

forall a,b,c R:
    min(min(a,b),c) <= min(a,b)
    min(min(a,b),c) <= c

forall x R, n N:
    x < 0
    =>:
        x^(2*n+1) < 0

forall x R, n N:
    x < 0
    =>:

claim:
    ? forall x,y R+, q R:
        q > 0
        x > y
        =>:
            x^q > y^q
    x^q > 0
    y^q > 0
    log(2,y) < log(2,x)
    q*log(2,y) < q*log(2,x)
    log(2,y^q) = q*log(2,y)
    log(2,x^q) = q*log(2,x)
    log(2,y^q) < log(2,x^q)
    by contra:
        ? x^q > y^q
        x^q <= y^q
        log(2,x^q) <= log(2,y^q)
        impossible log(2,y^q) < log(2,x^q)

forall x,y R+, q R:
    q > 0
    x > y
    =>:
        x^q > y^q

forall x,y R+, q R:
    q < 0
    x > y
    =>:
        x^q > y^q

forall a R+, u,v R:
    1 <= a
    u <= v
    =>:
        a^u <= a^v

forall a R+, n Z:
    1 <= a
    =>:
        a^n < a^(n+1)

claim:
    ? forall a R+, n Z:
        a < 1
        =>:
            a^(n+1) < a^n
    a^(n+1) = a^n*a^1 = a^n*a < a^n*1 = a^n

forall a R+, n Z:
    a < 1
    =>:
        a^(n+1) < a^n

claim:
    ? forall a R+, n Z:
        1 < a
        =>:
            a^n < a^(n+1)
    a^(n+1) = a^n*a^1 = a^n*a > a^n*1 = a^n

forall a R+, n Z:
    1 < a
    =>:
        a^n < a^(n+1)

claim:
    ? forall x,a,b R:
        x < a
        x < b
        =>:
            x < min(a,b)
    a <= b or a > b
    by cases:
        ? x < min(a,b)
        case a <= b:
            x < a = min(a,b)
        case a > b:
            b <= a
            x < b = min(a,b)

claim:
    ? forall x,y R+, q R:
        q > 0
        x > y
        =>:
            x^q > y^q
    x^q > 0
    y^q > 0
    1 < 2
    y < x
    log(2,y) < log(2,x)
    q*log(2,y) < q*log(2,x)
    log(2,y^q) = q*log(2,y)
    log(2,x^q) = q*log(2,x)
    log(2,y^q) < log(2,x^q)
    by contra:
        ? x^q > y^q
        x^q <= y^q
        log(2,x^q) <= log(2,y^q)
        impossible log(2,y^q) < log(2,x^q)

forall a,b R:
    b <= a
    =>:
        b = min(a,b)

forall a,b R:
    a > b
    =>:
        b = min(a,b)

forall x,a,b R:
    x <= a
    x <= b
    =>:
        x < min(a,b)

claim:
    ? forall x,y R+, q R:
        q > 0
        x > y
        =>:
            x^q > y^q
    x^q $in R+
    y^q $in R+
    x^q > 0
    y^q > 0
    1 < 2
    y < x
    log(2,y) < log(2,x)
    q*log(2,y) < q*log(2,x)
    log(2,y^q) = q*log(2,y)
    log(2,x^q) = q*log(2,x)
    log(2,y^q) < log(2,x^q)
    by contra:
        ? x^q > y^q
        x^q <= y^q
        log(2,x^q) <= log(2,y^q)
        impossible log(2,y^q) < log(2,x^q)
